meta.title: Activation succeeds with the pricing sheet filled and with it empty
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The vocabulary permits only one fresh setup record, so it cannot independently test activation on two separate events.

the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup and add_rfq_round operation do not expose a complete, explicit pricing-sheet value field set; the filled-sheet case is represented by the default round template and the empty-sheet case by data=[].
The plan cannot verify that a refusal is readable because no assertion operation exposes the response error body for publish_event.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer adds a pricing (RFQ) round to the event.
The buyer adds a pricing (RFQ) round to the event with no data.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is still a draft (not published).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event is still a draft (not published).
